from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u085/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            occupied = set(cells)
            outside = set()
            q = []
            for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                    if (y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)) and (y,x) not in occupied and (y,x) not in outside:
                        outside.add((y,x)); q.append((y,x))
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if r0<=yy<=r1 and c0<=xx<=c1 and (yy,xx) not in occupied and (yy,xx) not in outside:
                        outside.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            hollow = any((y,x) not in occupied and (y,x) not in outside for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1))
            objects.append(dict(color=color,cells=cells,r0=r0,r1=r1,c0=c0,c1=c1,hollow=hollow))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    placed = []
    # Hollow objects settle against the top; preserve their order when their
    # horizontal spans overlap.
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if o['hollow']), key=lambda o:o['r0']):
        dr = -obj['r0']
        while True:
            shifted = [(y+dr-1,x) for y,x in obj['cells']]
            if min(y for y,x in shifted) < 0 or any((y,x) in placed for y,x in shifted):
                break
            dr -= 1
        cells=[(y+dr,x) for y,x in obj['cells']]
        placed.extend(cells)
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=obj['color']
    # Non-hollow objects settle against the bottom.
    for obj in sorted((o for o in objects if not o['hollow']), key=lambda o:o['r1'], reverse=True):
        dr = h-1-obj['r1']
        while True:
            shifted = [(y+dr+1,x) for y,x in obj['cells']]
            if max(y for y,x in shifted) >= h or any((y,x) in placed for y,x in shifted):
                break
            dr += 1
        cells=[(y+dr,x) for y,x in obj['cells']]
        placed.extend(cells)
        for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=obj['color']
    return out
'''
